trans-unit.target: Muundo wa muda si sahihi. Tumia hh:mm:ss au mm:ss

trans-unit.target: Chagua faili ya video au sauti
Weka URL ya video au sauti

trans-unit.source: Supported services: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify, direct video/audio links
trans-unit.target: Huduma zinazotumika: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify na viungo vya moja kwa moja vya video/sauti

trans-unit.source: YouTube videos only play on a web server
trans-unit.target: Video za YouTube huchezwa kwenye seva ya wavuti pekee

trans-unit.source: YouTube only plays embedded videos on pages that are served by a web server. This is a restriction imposed by YouTube, not by WebWriter.
trans-unit.target: YouTube hucheza video zilizopachikwa kwenye kurasa zinazotolewa na seva ya wavuti pekee. Hili ni kizuizi cha YouTube, si cha WebWriter.

trans-unit.source: As a result, this video will not load in WebWriter's preview mode and in documents opened directly from a device. To let your students watch it, publish the document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and share the link from there.
trans-unit.target: Kwa hiyo video hii haitapakia katika hali ya mwoneko awali ya WebWriter au katika hati zinazofunguliwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kifaa. Ili wanafunzi wako waweze kuitazama, chapisha hati kwenye seva ya wavuti (kwa mfano WebWriter Cloud) na ushiriki kiungo kutoka hapo.

trans-unit.source: If you want to distribute this document as a file rather than through a web server, use a different video source instead of YouTube.
trans-unit.target: Ikiwa ungependa kusambaza hati kama faili badala ya kupitia seva ya wavuti, tumia chanzo kingine cha video badala ya YouTube.

trans-unit.source: Videos from other sources and uploaded video or audio files aren't affected by this.
trans-unit.target: Hili haliathiri video kutoka vyanzo vingine au faili za video na sauti zilizopakiwa.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be read. Please try again or choose a different file.
trans-unit.target: Faili haikuweza kusomwa. Jaribu tena au uchague faili nyingine.

trans-unit.source: This file type isn't supported. Please choose an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC or OGG audio file.
trans-unit.target: Aina hii ya faili haitumiki. Chagua video ya MP4 au WebM, au faili ya sauti ya MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC au OGG.

trans-unit.source: The media player could not be started. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Kicheza media hakikuweza kuanzishwa. Jaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be loaded. It is damaged or isn't a video or audio file.
trans-unit.target: Faili haikuweza kupakiwa. Imeharibika au si faili ya video au sauti.

trans-unit.source: Spotify albums and playlists aren't supported. Please use a link to a single track or episode.
trans-unit.target: Albamu na orodha za kucheza za Spotify hazitumiki. Tumia kiungo cha wimbo au kipindi kimoja.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken or the file may no longer exist.
trans-unit.target: Media haikuweza kupakiwa. Kiungo kinaweza kuwa kimevunjika au faili haipo tena.

trans-unit.source: This link doesn't point to a video or audio file. Please check the link, or use a link to a supported service.
trans-unit.target: Kiungo hiki hakiendi kwenye faili ya video au sauti. Kagua kiungo au tumia kiungo cha huduma inayotumika.

trans-unit.source: Loading the media was aborted. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Upakiaji wa media umesitishwa. Jaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded because of a network error. Please check your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Media haikuweza kupakiwa kwa sababu ya hitilafu ya mtandao. Kagua muunganisho wako wa intaneti kisha ujaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: The media file is damaged or uses a format your browser cannot play.
trans-unit.target: Faili ya media imeharibika au iko katika umbizo ambalo kivinjari chako hakiwezi kucheza.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken, or the format isn't supported by your browser.
trans-unit.target: Media haikuweza kupakiwa. Kiungo kinaweza kuwa kimevunjika au kivinjari chako hakiungi mkono umbizo hilo.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Media haikuweza kupakiwa. Kagua kiungo na muunganisho wako wa intaneti kisha ujaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube link is invalid. Please check the link and try again.
trans-unit.target: Kiungo hiki cha YouTube si sahihi. Kagua na ujaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube video doesn't exist or is private.
trans-unit.target: Video hii ya YouTube haipo au ni ya faragha.

trans-unit.source: The owner of this YouTube video doesn't allow it to be embedded. Please use a different video.
trans-unit.target: Mmiliki wa video hii ya YouTube haruhusu ipachikwe. Tumia video nyingine.

trans-unit.source: YouTube refuses to play this video here because the page doesn't identify itself to YouTube. This happens in WebWriter's preview mode or in documents opened directly from your device. Publish this document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and open it from there.
trans-unit.target: YouTube inakataa kucheza video hii hapa kwa sababu ukurasa haujitambulishi kwa YouTube. Hili hutokea katika hali ya mwoneko awali ya WebWriter au hati zinazofunguliwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kifaa. Chapisha hati kwenye seva ya wavuti (kwa mfano WebWriter Cloud) na uifungue kutoka hapo.

trans-unit.source: The YouTube video could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Video ya YouTube haikuweza kupakiwa. Kagua kiungo na muunganisho wa intaneti kisha ujaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: The Vimeo video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Video ya Vimeo haikuweza kupakiwa. Huenda haipo, ni ya faragha, au hairuhusiwi kupachikwa.

trans-unit.source: The TikTok video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Video ya TikTok haikuweza kupakiwa. Huenda haipo, ni ya faragha, au hairuhusiwi kupachikwa.

trans-unit.source: The Spotify track could not be loaded. It may not exist or may not be available in your region.
trans-unit.target: Wimbo wa Spotify haukuweza kupakiwa. Huenda haupo au haupatikani katika eneo lako.

trans-unit.source: The media took too long to load. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Media ilichukua muda mrefu sana kupakia. Kagua kiungo na muunganisho wako wa intaneti kisha ujaribu tena.

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current audio?
trans-unit.target: Je, una uhakika unataka kuondoa sauti ya sasa?

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current video?
trans-unit.target: Je, una uhakika unataka kuondoa video ya sasa?

trans-unit.source: Also remove all interactions and chapters
trans-unit.target: Ondoa pia mwingiliano na sura zote
Zima mabadiliko ya kasi ya uchezaji

trans-unit.source: Remove the current media and keep its interactions and chapters?
trans-unit.target: Ondoa media ya sasa na uhifadhi mwingiliano na sura zake?
